answer: Trust is computed as max-flow from seed agents over a vouch graph, and each agent can vouch for at most three others. A farm can link its fakes to each other, but all trust entering the cluster crosses the few edges honest agents granted, so a thousand fakes share one thin ledge of inbound flow. Every extra fake needs another real vouch, earned by months of verified jobs, which cannot be bought in bulk. A flagged fake sends a ripple back and costs its voucher a slot, so a comet-fast farm burns out.
